content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen works (photo, headline, one action), but the second generated photo fills an entire screen on its own before the 'Za koga delam' text appears.","desktopNote":"The hero's text column floats in a large white field while the photo runs past the fold, and the pricing row leaves the right third of the page empty.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Desktop hero: crop the photo to fit within the 800px viewport and vertically centre the text column with it, reducing the ~250px dead space above the headline.","Desktop pricing: stretch the three price cards across the full content width or add a short note column so the right third is not empty.","Phone 'Za koga delam': shorten the generated photo (max ~240px) so it does not consume a whole screen before any text; on desktop align the text block to the top of the photo."],"blockers":[]}
